patches.name: composed-auth-apikey-config
patches.reason: v4.8.0 generator wired only the OAuth bearer half of ServiceTitan composed auth; the ST-App-Key apiKey header half is missing. Adds StAppKey + TenantID fields to Config and reads ST_APP_KEY / ST_TENANT_ID env vars with TrimSpace.

patches.name: composed-auth-credentials-trim
patches.reason: Defensively TrimSpace all four ST_* env vars in Load(). JKA's environment has had leading whitespace on ST_CLIENT_ID multiple times, surfacing as opaque invalid_client 400s from /connect/token.

patches.name: tenant-env-config
patches.reason: Read ST_TENANT_ID into Config.TenantID so the sync registry can substitute {tenant} in path templates and downstream commands can derive defaults from it.

patches.name: composed-auth-apikey-wire
patches.reason: Inject the ST-App-Key header on every authenticated request alongside Authorization: Bearer; mirror the same header in dry-run output. Without this every authenticated endpoint returns 401 even with a valid OAuth bearer.

patches.name: composed-auth-doctor
patches.reason: Recognize composed-auth-ready state from credentials present (ST-App-Key + client_id/secret) rather than from an already-minted bearer (which is lazy). Require all four ST_* env vars in the env-var check and report N/4 available.

patches.name: sync-default-resources
patches.reason: Populate defaultSyncResources() with `estimates`. v4.8.0 emits empty for tenant-scoped specs, so plain `sync` silently no-ops.

patches.name: sync-paths-registry
patches.reason: Populate syncResourcePath() with the tenant-scoped estimates list path and substitute {tenant} from ST_TENANT_ID. v4.8.0 leaves the map empty and has no fill mechanism, so every sync invocation errored 'unknown sync resource'.
